svg.aria-label: RetrievAI Advanced. Chat with a document, and watch every retrieval stage get timed. 5 techniques, each a toggle, 3 file types: PDF, txt, csv, ms timed at every stage. Pluggable rate limiter. Guards paid external APIs, only where a call actually happens. 2 algorithms, 1 interface, 0 business-logic changes, 4 ways to key a limit.
